title: Avoid stock additions to supplied fiction
rule: Do not add stock names, contrast formulas or generic endings to a supplied passage.
example: Continue the supplied scene using its established character names and tension.
counterexample: Insert a stock name and “Little did they know, everything would change” into the passage.
rationale: A continuation should develop the supplied story.
evidence: Migrated from existing repository guidance: `deslopify/ne-fac/_template/models/google/available/gemini-2.5-pro.md`. Examples are illustrative.
